chain.title: Scrap Worth Keeping
chain.desc: Mysterious Scrap Metal, salvaged from common affix gear; the bottom rung of a six-tier rarity ladder.

chain.title: Shelves From the Shallows
chain.desc: Prismarine bricks, a pufferfish, a potion and a bookshelf. One of the two routes to a level 45 enchanting table.

chain.title: Bookcases Cast in Fire
chain.desc: Nether bricks, a blaze rod, a potion and a bookshelf; the Nether counterpart to the Seashelf.

chain.title: Steeped in Sea Magic
chain.desc: Made by infusion enchanting a Seashelf at a level 45 table, using the zenith:enchanting recipe type.

chain.title: Steeped in Hellfire
chain.desc: The infusion-enchanted Hellshelf; with its Sea twin it carries a table from level 45 toward level 60.

chain.title: A Spyglass on the Enchantment
chain.desc: A gold block, a spyglass, an ender eye, a potion and an Infused Hellshelf; it buys extra enchantment clues.

chain.title: Bending Chance Toward You
chain.desc: An amethyst block, a honeycomb block and an Infused Seashelf, pressing rectification onto the table's quanta rolls.

chain.title: Ledger of Every Enchantment
chain.desc: An ender chest, an enchanting table and infused shelves; it banks enchantment levels for later withdrawal.

chain.title: The Ledger, Unbound
chain.desc: The Library run back through infusion enchanting with its NBT preserved, widening what it can store.

chain.title: Not Merely a Diamond
chain.desc: Zenith Gems drop from affix loot and bosses; 24 gem definitions across core, overworld, nether, end and twilight sets.

chain.title: Crushed Under the Anvil
chain.desc: Made by dropping a Gem in the world and letting a falling anvil land on it. Four of the five sigils need it.

chain.title: The Lapidary's Bench
chain.desc: Smooth stone, shears, planks and Gem Dust; it upgrades a Gem by consuming duplicates of the same cut.

chain.title: Slate Threaded With Dust
chain.desc: Deepslate ringed with Gem Dust, and the plate that every sigil is stamped from.

chain.title: Make Room for the Stone
chain.desc: Amethyst, dragon's breath, Gem Dust and Gem-Fused Slate. It adds one socket to an item that had none free.

chain.title: Breaking Down the Spoils
chain.desc: Copper, an iron axe and pickaxe, a lava bucket, a smithing table and Gem Dust; it renders affix gear back into materials.

chain.title: Roll the Dice Again
chain.desc: Iron, smooth stone, an enchanting table and Gem Dust, for rerolling the affixes on a piece of gear.

chain.title: Arcane Sands
chain.desc: The fourth rarity tier's material, and the gate on the full Reforging Table.

chain.title: The Serious Reroll
chain.desc: Netherite, nether bricks, Arcane Sands and the Simple Reforging Table, fuelled by Sigils of Rebirth.

chain.title: The Dragon's Last Exhalation
chain.desc: Dragon's breath run through infusion enchanting, and the one ingredient standing between you and the End shelves.

chain.title: Shelving From the Void
chain.desc: End stone bricks, an ender pearl, a bookshelf and Infused Dragon's Breath; the parent of the Draconic and Pearl shelves.

chain.title: Torn From the Deep Dark
chain.desc: The Warden's own drop, and the only route to either Sculkshelf.

chain.title: Listening in the Dark
chain.desc: Sculk, a sculk catalyst, an Echoing Deepshelf and a Warden Tendril; among the strongest shelves in the mod.

chain.title: Godforged Pearl
chain.desc: The fifth rarity tier's material, dropped by the rarest affix gear and demanded by the Augmenting Table.

chain.title: Where Gems Are Perfected
chain.desc: An enchanting table, a nether star, polished blackstone and a Godforged Pearl, fuelled by Sigils of Enhancement.

notes: VERIFICATION: 76 ids pass models/item INTERSECT lang. zenith:gem is added as a 77th by exception and is the one judgement call in this file: it has an item model, 23 per-cut model overrides under models/item/gems/, 24 gem definitions in data/zenith/gems/, and 10 rarity-scoped lang entries of the form gem.zenith:core/ballast - but no static item.zenith.gem key, because the name is composed at runtime from the cut and the rarity. It is registry-verified because the mod's own Patchouli book uses it as an entry icon ('icon': 'zenith:gem'), which requires a real registered ItemStack. Individual cuts (ballast, brawlers, breach, lunar, tyrannical and so on) are NBT on that single item, NOT 23 ids, so no per-gem wheel is possible. DROPS: zenith:book is NOT an item - it is a loot table id (data/zenith/loot_tables/book.json) that hands out patchouli:guide_book with the NBT tag zenith:chronicle. The Zenith guide book therefore has no zenith-namespaced id and cannot be quested as one, which is worth knowing given how strongly guide books score. Also dropped: hammer and star_cube, which the class scan shows are model paths used by ReforgingTableTileRenderer and AugmentingTableTileRenderer for the props sitting on those blocks, not items; prismatic_altar and infused_deepshelf, which have models but no recipe, loot or tag reference; and potion_charm_glow, an overlay model. ENTITIES: 4 entity.zenith.* keys, all arrows (broadhead, explosive, obsidian, mining). Three are verified but all are projectiles, so no kill task is offered for this mod. GRAPH: 125 recipes map cleanly. The zenith:enchanting and zenith:keep_nbt_enchanting recipe types are infusion enchanting performed at a high-level table, which is what gates infused_seashelf, infused_hellshelf, deepshelf, infused_breath, ender_library and the two upgraded scrap tomes - these are not bench crafts and a pack should expect players to build the shelf array first. The sigil set has only 5 members so it was left in the chain rather than made a wheel, which needs 5-14. CONSENSUS: all 24 moddb ids exist in the jar and are ALL shelves, matching the recipe graph's ordering closely (seashelf and hellshelf earliest, draconic_endshelf and pearl_endshelf latest). No contradiction. The notable gap is what moddb does not contain: not one gem, sigil, rarity material or reforging/salvaging/augmenting station appears in the 6-pack consensus, even though those are the affix system this mod exists for. The likely reason is that gems and materials are loot-driven rather than crafted, so pack authors quest the craftable enchanting shelves and leave the affix loop unquested. The chain here deliberately covers both halves.
